title: Merle Ambrose shows a '!' to a new wizard that goes away within a second of accepting WC-MAIN-C01-001, and Mr. Lincoln, whom its goal names, shows a '?'
notes: 7.08: each NPC a wizard sees is sent MSG_WIZBANG with the marker its menu earns for that wizard: StartQuest ('!') for a quest it offers, CompleteQuestGoal ('?') for a goal the wizard completes with it, outranking StartQuest, and None otherwise. A change is sent at once, and the markers are sent again every Npc.WizbangResendInterval.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server puts the wizard in Merle Ambrose's house
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/Interiors/WC_Headmistress_House instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: Merle Ambrose shows a '!' to the new wizard
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} was shown the (\S+) wizbang over NPC \d+ \(template 38168\)

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the '!' over Merle Ambrose
the wizard stands 200 units from Merle Ambrose, facing him
the camera settles by Merle Ambrose
the wizard takes a step toward Merle Ambrose
walking up to Merle Ambrose offers WC-MAIN-C01-001
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} entered the service range of NPC \d+ \(template (\d+), mobile id \d+, \S+ with icon \S+\) and was shown 1 option

steps.name: the prompt of Merle Ambrose
press X, as the prompt asks
the server offers WC-MAIN-C01-001
the first Prep line
MORE shows the second Prep line beside the offer window
the second Prep line and the offer window
ACCEPT takes the quest

until.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} accepted quest (\S+) from NPC \d+ with 1 start goal

steps.name: the dialogue and offer window close on ACCEPT
the '!' over Merle Ambrose goes away on accepting
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} was shown the (\S+) wizbang over NPC \d+ \(template 38168\)

steps.name: Merle Ambrose with no marker
open the chat line to type .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood
clear the slash the key typed before .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood
type .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood
send .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood
the client is asked to leave the house for Ravenwood
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked its client to leave WizardCity/Interiors/WC_Headmistress_House for WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood

steps.name: the client is sent to Ravenwood with a transfer key
steps.pattern: sent wizard {wizard_guid} from WizardCity/Interiors/WC_Headmistress_House to WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood at (\S+) with a single-use transfer key

steps.name: the client attaches again with the transfer key
the wizard arrives in Ravenwood
Mr. Lincoln shows a '?' for the goal
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} was shown the (\S+) wizbang over NPC \d+ \(template 39088\)

steps.name: the client loads Ravenwood
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard stands 300 units from Mr. Lincoln, facing him
the '?' over Mr. Lincoln
